style: photoreal video, vertical 9:16 frame, real hamster, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
subject: ONE ginger hamster, cat-sized, deadpan, never blinks; cheeks twice his head, flat and thin from 5.4
second_characters: cashier, dry woman, off screen: only her hand and teal sleeve
props: her terminal, red cross only; ONE folded green banknote, his, in his mouth; coins: his cheeks, 5.4 her steel dish, 7.0 around him; ONE loaf, his, on the counter, 8.0 her hand, 9.2 his mouth
environment: sunny checkout: shop window, mint wall, glowing fridge without sign, black counter, gum rack of plain colored packs
lighting: warm key on his face; gold rim from window, cyan rim from fridge
motion_rule: camera moves only at 0.00, 6.90, 9.20; other segments cut to a new angle with a foreground object; he stays mostly in place
